analysis.investment_thesis: A small-cap aerospace & defense play growing revenue at 45.8% CAGR with expanding margins (EBITDA 28%), riding India's defense indigenization tailwind. However, persistently negative operating cash flow (1/4 years positive) and a 73x P/E leave no margin for execution slippage.
key_strengths: Revenue 45.8% CAGR (2022→2025) with EBITDA expanding faster at 48.5% — operating leverage kicking in.
Strong promoter holding (68%) in a structural growth sector (Indian defense/aerospace indigenization).
ROCE of 23.65% indicates efficient capital deployment despite capex-heavy phase.
key_risks: Operating cash flow negative 3 of last 4 years (-₹3 Cr in 2025) — growth funded by equity/debt, not internal accruals.
Valuation stretched: 73x P/E and 10.9x P/B price in flawless execution.
Working-capital intensity typical of defense contractors (long receivable cycles) — FCF gap persists.
red_flags: FCF cumulatively negative ₹65 Cr over 2023-2025 despite reported profit growth.
Near-zero institutional holding (FII 0.01%, DII 0.66%) — limited scrutiny / liquidity.
Cash balance fell from ₹17 Cr to ₹3 Cr in 2025 while OCF remained negative.
analysis.detailed_analysis:
From my scuttlebutt lens, this is the kind of small, founder-led industrial name I would want to investigate further — India's defense indigenization offers a multi-decade runway, and the revenue trajectory (₹47→146 Cr) with expanding EBITDA margins (27%→28%) suggests a genuine product-market fit rather than one-off order lumpiness. Promoter skin-in-the-game at 68% and ROCE above 23% are the right qualitative markers of a disciplined operator. R&D disclosure is absent in the data, which for an aerospace & defense company is a material gap I'd need to close via channel checks on customers (likely HAL/DRDO/MoD) and engineering talent depth.

The disqualifier at today's price is the cash conversion: reported net profit of ₹24 Cr against ₹-3 Cr operating cash flow means the earnings are not yet self-funding, and the 2024 equity raise (equity jumping ₹25→₹126 Cr) is what financed the working-capital build. At 73x earnings and 10.9x book, the market is already paying for several more years of 45%+ growth with no stumbles — a price I would only tolerate if cash-flow quality improves. I'd watch for OCF turning decisively positive and would prefer to build a position on a valuation reset closer to 35-40x, rather than chase here.
